notes.title: Badges, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds and Emoticons
notes.notes:
Exciting News! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce that our game now features Badges, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, and Emoticons! 🃏✨

Start collecting, trading, and customizing your profile to show off your style. Dive in and unlock these awesome rewards today!

Happy gaming! 🎮🎨

notes.title: Jesus Christ RPG Trilogy Soundtrack
notes.notes:
If you like this humble RPG trilogy, please consider purchasing the official Jesus Christ RPG Trilogy soundtrack.

At the moment there are 7 songs to be downloaded. However by Easter Sunday, I should have the 2 arranged tracks that I'm working on completely mixed for your sonic delight.
